reviews.text: 第一把在地图上捡到金子后一定要去左下角商店里解锁点击工厂和AOE建筑，第三波几十只怪物没有AOE肯定是过不了的；或者换个思路，点开迷雾后抓紧把出怪口点杀了，虽然不能减少怪物数量，但至少可以把出怪的方向控制到一条路上；这种不靠局外养成要素必定不能通关的肉鸽不太对我胃口，但是创意还是值得好评的； 还有，小游戏没有自带的锁帧和垂直同步，所以GPU会跑满，可以考虑进N卡的控制面板强行锁帧，降低硬件负载。 仔细玩了一下，游戏有一个最大的问题就是缺乏变化，作为轻型肉鸽也就地图是随机的，游戏的生存建造策略其实算是固定的，然后地图探索又没什么东西，千篇一律的地形，除了宝箱就是无边无尽的出怪口了，没有生存100天的动力；如果探索时会出现像雪地啊、祭坛啊这种不同的地形或者功能性建筑，会更有趣些；反正就是22块体验一下还行，没有持续游玩的欲望。

I enjoyed half my playtime, the rest was dull and tedious and unrewarding. It saddens me to leave a bad revieuw but in it's current state I DO NOT reccomend. The concept of the game is great, it's enough to entertain you for 2 hours or so after that it's just too repetetive and not really challenging.. There are also upgrades and building that are suppoced to make your life easier but you have to mannually refill their clicks, wich if you have a lot of building surrounding it you'll have to conctantly upkeep all across the map, and map movement is slow.. Your objective is to make it to day 100 and you'd think this would be the GRAND FINALY but the wave is especially pathetic, it's like the power level of day 10 but half.. Making you waist time prepping for something you could have just skipped to from day 50 in my expierience. The cons: It's a rogue lite, meaning you keep whatever you've unlocked on following playthroughs. The game is exceptionally challenging on the first 1/2 playthroughs, especially on day 10. But once you make it to day 20-30 the game difficulty just drops DRASTICALLY and it just becomes a waiting game and CLICKING simulator. Where you have to pause in order to spend all of your clicks, trying to min-max for no reason since it doesn't really matter, the ennemys grow weaker instead of stronger, the waves become smaller instead of larger and your upgrades are permanent so wether it takes you 1 attempt or 20, eventually you just auto-win. That aside most of the "upgrades" are irrelavent or useless, you either don't need them or they simply don't add anything to your progress and success, but you might as well since you'll have too much gold you don't know what to do with in the endgame. SUMMARY PROS & CONS Pro's: Interesting concept Fun for 1-2 hours. Some amount of strategy. Room for improvement/potential (new towers, ennemys, game balance, graphics, quality of life). Cons: No skill required. Clicks don't really matter much in the endgame. There is no option to auto-expend clicks on buildings that (save you on clicks and auto-distribute) If you want to build things you have to keep clicking on the thing you want to build and placement, instead of just clicking once to select and then place as many times as wanted, or have a quick keyboard button.. Only a couple of hours in entertainment Early game is "hard" end game is "sad". Wave 100 your END GOAL is especially underwhelming.. MOST upgrades for extra buildings or towers aren't adding any specific vallue or punch.

《Clickyland》是一款塔防村庄建设游戏，玩家需要通过点击来收集资源、建造防御建筑和管理村庄。游戏的目标是生存到第100天，面对逐渐增强的敌人波次。每一天玩家都有固定数量的点击可以使用，因此如何高效地分配这些点击资源成为游戏的核心挑战。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38287879]网易UU鉴赏家培养计划[/url][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注UU加速器VX公众号，回复“steam”，获得专属玩家群邀请。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1] 游戏的核心机制围绕点击展开。玩家可以通过点击树木来收集木材，点击敌人来攻击，或者点击雾气来揭示地图的更多区域。点击不仅是资源获取的方式，也是与敌人战斗和探索世界的主要手段。 资源管理： 木材、石头和食物是三种主要资源，玩家需要通过点击不同的对象来收集。 建造采石场可以使每次点击自动获取3块石头，建造点击工厂可以增加每次点击的收益，从而提高资源获取效率。 建造与防御： 游戏中有超过35种建筑和升级可以解锁，玩家可以通过建设防御塔、箭塔和其他防御设施来抵御敌人的进攻。 每次通过一个敌人波次，玩家都会获得金币，可以在商店购买新塔和升级，如快速点击等，以便在后续的波次中更好地生存。 敌人类型： 游戏中有超过30种不同的敌人，从简单的老鼠，蜘蛛到强大的恶魔萨满，每种敌人都有独特的攻击方式和防御机制，需要玩家采用不同的策略来应对。 《Clickyland》的画面采用了简约但不失精致的美术风格。每个建筑和敌人都设计得十分可爱，同时细节也处理得非常到位。音效方面，游戏的背景音乐舒缓而富有节奏感，让人能够在紧张的塔防战斗中保持一份轻松愉快的心情。游戏难度随着天数的增加逐渐提升。前几天的敌人相对简单，玩家可以轻松应对，但随着游戏进展，敌人变得越来越强，玩家需要合理规划资源和防御策略来应对挑战。这种渐进的难度曲线让游戏既具有挑战性，又不会让玩家感到过于挫败。 游戏在塔防游戏中引入了点击资源管理的概念，这一创新设计使得游戏不仅仅依赖于防御塔的建设，更强调了玩家在资源分配和策略制定方面的能力。这种独特的玩法使得《Clickyland》在众多塔防游戏中脱颖而出，给人耳目一新的感觉。 优点 创新玩法：将点击与塔防相结合的玩法新颖有趣，增加了游戏的深度和策略性。 高重玩性：每次游戏的关卡都是程序生成的，保证了每次游戏体验的独特性。 丰富内容：超过35种建筑和30种敌人类型，使得游戏内容丰富多样，玩家可以尝试不同的策略和玩法。 缺点 前期较为单调：游戏前期由于敌人较少，挑战性不足，可能会让一些玩家感到乏味。 点击操作较多：长时间的点击操作可能会让一些玩家感到疲劳，影响游戏体验。 总结：《Clickyland》是一款极具创新性和挑战性的塔防游戏。它通过巧妙地结合点击资源管理和塔防元素，为玩家带来了全新的游戏体验。虽然前期节奏稍显缓慢，但随着游戏的深入，玩家会发现其中的策略深度和多样性。对于喜欢策略和塔防游戏的玩家来说，《Clickyland》绝对是一款值得尝试的佳作。

游戏的玩法略微有点新鲜，通过限制鼠标点击次数，把它变成一种战略资源，玩家需要兼顾扩大生产和基础建设，存活100天。 乍一看没什么问题，但是作者对游戏内容的设计显然是有点幽默在里面的。 首先是游戏内容的匮乏。只要经营的好，玩家在前40天的时间内就可以解锁所有可建造建筑，并构筑出一套压倒性的防御系统，让怪物从刷怪点出现时就被秒杀。这导致后60天的游戏体验完全就是坐牢。 另外是怪物的设计。我非常想吐槽的是游戏中一种叫做“树人”的怪物，它对防御塔隐身，和游戏中的树木长得一摸一样，处理方式只能是玩家用找你妹的方式拿鼠标点击杀死。这就很幽默了，考虑到游戏中后期贫乏枯燥的流程，这就相当于把玩家当猴耍。 因此我要给它一个差评。20块钱你可以买到的是2小时的快乐和之后无尽的折磨。
游戏点子还不错。但是超级无敌卡，然后石头贴图大大小小满屏幕飞，体验非常不好。然后那个工厂的贴图也卡的不行。我本来以为这个游戏很小，可以很流畅地玩，没想到玩的这么这么不流畅！我好喜欢stackland本来对这个游戏期待挺高的，但实在玩不了。干酒就玩了三十天吧，这个已经卡的基本动不了了。

Not recommended. In fact, I'd recommend to AVOID THIS GAME LIKE THE PLAGUE. You have to survive for 100 days. By half game you have to click 300+ times per day, clicking on the same buildings again and again, every single day. I got to wave 75, my finger hurt like hell, there's nothing more to see, except hurting my fingers. This game is probably the best way to trigger a finger injury or awake a latent carpal tunnel syndrome. I could probably force myself to click another twenty thousand times to reach the final wave, the game is pretty easy once you get the gist of it, but I will hurt for 2 weeks if I continue clicking. Better stop now. Worst thing is, there is zero replayability after reaching two third of the game. If I start a new play, I will have to start over from day 1 and I will have to click tens of thousands of times again, then it will hurt like hell and will force me to stop long before the ending. It's utterly pointless. I might as well resign and uninstall the game. By the way, I'm experiencing a massive drop in FPS since half game. Quite disappointing for a basic 2D game. I'm playing on a 7950X with a RX 7900 XTX, which is the best hardware right now. I'd question whether the game is playable on a modest computer. Somehow your experience could be worse than mine, if you have to click twenty thousand times... on a 5 FPS slide show. P.S. Don't mind the 10 hours playtime, I forgot to turn off the game while I went away. My real playtime is 4 hours top.

袜子社新游，可爱的小品级 TD，4h左右100%。[spoiler]如果事先知道科技树上哪些有用，大概2h就可以吧([/spoiler] 玩起来还挺上头的，这几小时游玩也不觉得是浪费时间，但游戏的设计存在明显问题，以红评形式给篇中评。 [h3]没有任何机制限制扩张[/h3] clickyland 作为一款 基地建设/TD 游戏，玩起来也有一些 RTS 的感觉，但它最大的问题是，没有任何机制限制玩家扩张 (不论是通过刷怪还是经典的维护费)，而扩张的收益实在太高了。 点出点击上限后，采木/采石 即使不造任何配套设施，也不用点击充能，纯当一次性使用，收益也是投入的三倍以上。 敌人的攻击目标都是确定的，攻高血厚的强力怪很多只以大本为目标，完全不打塔。扩张开在没用的空地码满狙击塔，不仅让这些最困难的敌人变得毫无威胁，也提供了很高的容错。 扩张后还可以摧毁刷怪点，摧毁后可以获得大量资源。全图只有5个左右的无敌刷怪点，无脑扩出去清光全图可摧毁的刷怪点，守无敌刷怪点就完事了。 [h3]建筑设计不够平衡[/h3] 管理站可以说是全游戏最强的建筑，它不仅相当于三倍点击产能 (建筑密集区日收益远超点击工厂)，也可以当成类似 RTS 建造队列的缓存区，大幅节省操作。 而别的一些建筑 (尤其是弱的塔)，可以说不明所以，完全没有造的必要。 [h3]现有内容缺乏打磨[/h3] 中后期 50 到 100 波感觉比较重复，作为通关条件的第 100 波甚至没有设计特殊的敌人或者 boss。 QoL 极度欠缺，敌人没清完无法跳转到交战位置，得全图狠狠找。建筑规模大了后，即使拉满管理站，点出 shift 5 连点，每天也得全图拖一圈点近20下。 [spoiler]没管理站会有多难受我不敢想，其他没通关的红评说每天点好几百下毫不夸张([/spoiler]

毫无优化水平可言，配置稍差的电脑玩到后面就要崩溃，为了通个关还要去网鱼一趟。哪怕是网鱼的高配电脑，也会卡。最折磨的是我都过100天了，唯独差一个让城堡着火的成就，硬是在无尽模式又等了50多天。商店的设定并没有给游戏增添策略性，因为不把科技点出来，是不知道其实战效果的，实际上玩起来就是开荒的时候特别不好过。又由于科技一旦点出就一劳永逸，解锁关键科技之后又陷入了千篇一律的割草。不同防御塔之间的配合可有可无，只用2种防御塔便可应对所有情况。

I went into this game as a big fan of the developer's other similar game, "Stacklands". Although the two games bear similar minimalist themes, visuals, and sound; it's clear that "Clickyland" is much less polished or even finished as a game. The gameplay is trivially easy after unlocking a few upgrades and making it past the first 25 days or so out of 100. Resources are practically infinite, and I found myself struggling to find anything to do besides clear every last piece of grass, cut down every tree, break every rock, etc. There is no content, there is no strategy, and enemies are pathetically weak. I'd recommend almost any other tower defense game over this.

Started weak, then gets a little fun by waves 10-20, then takes a massive nosedive in fun after that. All due to the sheer annoying volume of management clicks you have to make. I had cleared the entire map except the invincible spawners by wave 25. That left me basically fortifying around the remaining spawners with 75 waves left to deal with. Ugh. Plus as time goes on, you have more and more and more management clicks to make. Eventually you're just cycling to new resource patches as you consume everything. It's a super boring gameplay loop because it takes FOREVER. I cannot imagine trying to get to wave 100 only to lose for whatever reason, having to start over. It's way, way too bloated of a game. I got it in a humble bundle so I'm not too disappointed but even for $5 this isn't worth it to me. I ended up closing the game wishing for my time back.
